perspective:
Angela’s accessible information:

- She is Angela Hwang, a hairdresser; she and Kevin Flores have been friends since high school. She knows Kevin works in construction.
- Angela noticed Kevin seemed unhappy with his job, so she invited him to coffee.
- At coffee, Angela heard Kevin say he had been “alright, just the usual grind,” but he admitted he was not happy, felt stuck and unfulfilled, and was going through the motions. She suggested a different job or career path. Kevin said he had thought about it but didn’t know where to start and felt overwhelmed. Angela offered to look into options together; Kevin thanked her.
- Angela found job openings and a career counseling service. She told Kevin about them. Kevin thanked her. Angela asked if he had thought more; Kevin said he had, and was interested in something creative, maybe design or architecture. Angela encouraged him to check the resources; Kevin agreed.
- Angela believed Kevin was considering a career change and felt supportive and hopeful.
- Angela believed Kevin was hesitant about changing careers and felt frustrated and worried. She arranged a meeting with a career coach and told Kevin she believed in him. Kevin said she didn’t have to, appreciated it, but wasn’t sure he was ready. Angela said a push could help and the coach could help him make a plan and gain confidence. Kevin agreed to try. Angela promised to support him.
- Angela believed Kevin was making progress and felt proud and relieved. She checked in about the career coach. Kevin told her the coach was helpful, he had started online design courses, and he felt more confident. Angela offered further help; Kevin said her support was enough and he would ask if he needed anything.
- Angela believed Kevin had successfully transitioned to a new career and felt happy and satisfied. She organized a small celebration party and told Kevin. Kevin thanked her, said he was grateful, and said he couldn’t have done it without her. Angela said he did the hard work and invited him to enjoy the party.
